prod-bot: ALERT: Canary deploy 2026-03-17T10:12Z -> model-serving-v3 (canary=10%) is reporting a 5xx rate increase: 2.8% (baseline 0.05%). Trigger: canary-health-check-threshold. Auto-rollback did NOT fire (error: metric not mapped). Paging on-call @oncall-jai

oncall-jai: I'm on it, pulling logs and checking the rollout config now.

sre-oliver: Noted. Which feature flag controls the traffic split for this rollout?

eng-anna: flag name is `feature.model_v3_rollout`, rollout-service handles the split. We also merged the quantization change yesterday that touched the decode path.

oncall-jai: Copy. I'm going to flip the kill-switch (set canary to 0%) while we triage. @eng-anna can you stand by with a rollback artifact if needed?

eng-anna: Standby. Manual rollback command I have ready: `redwood deploy rollback --release model-serving-v3 --target stable --reason "canary 5xx spike"` — release id: release-20260317-09 uploaded.

sre-oliver: Before full rollback, try draining traffic first and check for pod OOMs / traces. Control-plane flag toggle: `curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/flags/model_v3_rollout -d 'value=0'`

oncall-jai: Flipping flag now.

oncall-jai: Done :white_check_mark: Can confirm control-plane reported canary=0%. Pulling recent logs: `kubectl logs -l app=model-serving,canary=true --since=5m | grep ERROR | head` shows repeated `decode()` exceptions and one OOM event on a canary pod.

eng-anna: That matches the quantization change hypothesis — decode path hitting an edge-case allocation. If drain doesn't stabilize in 5m we should execute the manual rollback.

pm-lin: Customer impact: Pager from enterprise-tp shows ~4 customers had failed requests in the last 10m. No SLA breach detected yet but we should notify affected customers and follow runbook.

oncall-jai: Error rate dropped to 0.07% within 90s after flag flip. No new OOMs in last 2m. Keeping canary pinned at 0% and monitoring for 15 minutes.

sre-oliver: Good containment. Hold off rollback for now if metrics stay stable. We still need a root-cause action: ask model team to revert the quantization commit or add memory headroom. @eng-anna please open a ticket and schedule a repro run.

eng-anna: Ticket created: INF-3217 with logs, pod traces, and the failing request sample. I'll run a staging repro with `QUANTIZE=off` and a controlled load, then propose a patched candidate.

pm-lin: I'll draft a short customer note: "We observed a brief canary spike that affected a small set of requests; traffic was drained and the issue mitigated. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."

prod-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: canary traffic set to 0%, errors reduced to baseline. Severity adjusted S2 -> monitoring. If stable for 15m with no regressions we'll resolve and hand off to engineering for RCA.

oncall-jai: Monitoring window complete, no regressions observed. Handing back to eng-anna for follow-up / RCA. :wave:

eng-anna: Acknowledged, I'll run the staged repro and keep this thread updated with patch and re-ramp plan.

prod-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED -> status: mitigated, follow-up ticket INF-3217 assigned to eng-anna.
